units.source_text: 且说这一年，宫中常常发生不祥之兆，变异之事接连而起。

en.t: Now in that year, ominous signs often appeared at court, and strange disturbances followed one after another.

units.source_text: 三月十三日，雷电交加、风雨狂暴之夜，朱雀帝做一个梦，

en.t: On the thirteenth day of the third month, on a night of thunder, lightning, and raging wind and rain, Emperor Suzaku had a dream,

units.source_text: 看见桐壶上皇站在清凉殿正面的阶下，脸色非常不快，

en.t: in which he saw the retired Emperor Kiritsubo standing below the front steps of the Seiryoden, his expression deeply displeased,

units.source_text: 两眼注视朱雀帝，朱雀帝默不作声，肃立听命。

en.t: his eyes fixed on Emperor Suzaku, while Suzaku stood silently and solemnly to receive his command.

units.source_text: 桐壶上皇晓谕的话甚多，主要的似乎是关于源氏公子之事。

en.t: The retired Emperor Kiritsubo spoke many words of admonition, and they seemed mainly to concern Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝醒来，非常恐怖，又很悲痛，便把这梦禀告弘徽殿太后。

en.t: When Emperor Suzaku awoke, he was terrified and deeply saddened, and he reported the dream to the Empress Mother of Kokiden.

units.source_text: 太后说：“风雨交作、天气险恶之夜，昼间所思之事，往往入梦。

en.t: The Empress Mother said, On nights when wind and rain clash and the weather is fierce, things one thinks about during the day often enter dreams.

units.source_text: 此乃寻常之事，不必担心。”

en.t: This is quite ordinary, and there is no need to worry.

units.source_text: 大约是梦中与父皇四目相射之故，朱雀帝忽然患了眼疾，痛苦不堪。

en.t: Perhaps because his eyes had met his father's in the dream, Emperor Suzaku suddenly developed an eye illness and suffered unbearably.

units.source_text: 宫中及弘徽殿内便大办法事，祈祷眼疾早愈。

en.t: Great Buddhist rites were then held both in the palace and within Kokiden, with prayers for his eye illness to heal quickly.
